title: Scope and Terms of Reference of Future Economy Council
what_it_is: Scope and Terms of Reference of Future Economy Council

sections.label: Future Economy Council oversight role
sections.summary: The Future Economy Council will oversee implementation of CFE recommendations and build on earlier Council on Skills, Innovation and Productivity work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: The Future Economy Council (FEC) will oversee the implementation of the CFE recommendations and will build on the work of the earlier Council on Skills, Innovation and Productivity, which includes SkillsFuture initiatives and the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: At its core, the scope and focus of FEC are on growing and transforming Singapore's economy for the benefit of our people.

sections.label: FEC subcommittees and Construction ITM
sections.summary: Six tripartite FEC subcommittees coordinate six industry clusters, and BCA identified 35 key technologies for R&D under the Construction ITM.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: Besides the main Council, six tripartite FEC subcommittees, led by private and public sector co-chairs, are coordinating the efforts for six clusters of industries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: As part of the Construction ITM under the subcommittee, the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) brought together 400 industry stakeholders, including IHLs and TACs, such as the Real Estate Developers' Association of Singapore (REDAS) and the Singapore Institute of Building Ltd (SIBL), and identified 35 key technologies across seven clusters in the built environment for further research and development (R&D) to unlock greater productivity gains.

sections.label: ITMs as live plans
sections.summary: The speaker characterises the ITMs as live plans that must be continuously monitored, updated and reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: Rather, I would characterise the ITMs as live plans that we will have to continuously monitor, update and review.

sections.label: Ideas incorporated into CFE recommendations
sections.summary: Many of the ideas were incorporated into the CFE recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: Many of the ideas were incorporated into the CFE recommendations.

sections.label: FEC continuing CFE engagements
sections.summary: The FEC and its six subcommittees are continuing and building on engagements and consultations started during the CFE process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: FEC and its six subcommittees are continuing with and building on the engagements and consultations that were started as part of the CFE process.

sections.label: Concern about left-behind workforce
sections.summary: The speaker is really concerned about the possibility of a segment of the workforce being left behind.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Two, I am really concerned about the possibility of a segment of the workforce being left behind.

sections.label: New broad-based curriculum study
sections.summary: Whether there should be a new broad-based curriculum for everybody is something that would have to be studied further.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: As to whether there should be a new broad-based curriculum for everybody, that is something which we would have to study further.

sections.label: Elderly and low-skilled workers
sections.summary: Concerns that elderly and low-skilled workers are being left behind are of great concern, and they are one area being worked on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: The second question on the concerns that elderly and low-skilled workers are being left behind is something that is of great concern.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: Indeed, the elderly and the low-skilled are one area that we are working on.
